lines.en: I glide through the water.
My tentacles trail behind.
I keep to the sea floor.

lines.zh: 我这一条身子拖得很长。
lines.en: My body trails out long behind me.
I go around the coral.
I push off with a tentacle.

lines.zh: 我贴着礁石一寸寸往上。
lines.en: I work my way up inch by inch along the reef.
I swim past a bed of kelp.

lines.zh: 我这身子掉头，要绕一大圈。
lines.en: To turn this body, I must swing a wide loop.
I stop and drift.
My head is pointed.
I slip between the reef rocks.
I float in the water.
My tentacles curl slowly.

lines.zh: 我望着透下来的那点光。
lines.en: I watch the little light coming down.

lines.zh: 我这双大眼在暗处发亮。
lines.en: My huge eyes shine in the dark.
I hang still, tentacles down.
I wait for something to swim by.

lines.zh: 触手一条条盘在我底下。
lines.en: One by one my tentacles coil beneath me.

lines.zh: 我把水里的声音都收进来。
lines.en: I draw in every sound the water carries.
I jet a little ink.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过去，触手先动。
lines.en: I turn away; my tentacles lead.
My gills move.
I hide in the kelp.
I rest my head on the reef.
I count the bubbles above.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上，水正往上涨。
lines.en: You stand on the shore; the water is rising.
You shouldn't come in the water.
I swim to your feet.
This water you stand in is mine.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁锈味，我闻得到。
lines.en: I can smell the rust of iron on you.
I circle you along the sea floor.

lines.zh: 你退了一步，水到了膝盖。
lines.en: You step back; the water reaches your knees.

lines.zh: 水再浅一点，我就能碰到你。
lines.en: A little shallower and I can touch you.

lines.zh: 你手里那东西挡不住水。
lines.en: What you hold won't stop the water.
I rise from behind the reef.

lines.zh: 你脚踝露着，我盯了很久。
lines.en: Your ankle shows; I have stared a long while.
Where you stand is shallow.

lines.zh: 海水从你的靴口灌进去了。
lines.en: Seawater has poured in at your boot tops.
I rise to the surface.

lines.zh: 你的鞋尖已经泡在水里。
lines.en: The toe of your shoe is already in the water.

lines.zh: 我贴着石头绕到你左边。
lines.en: I slip along the rocks to your left.
I sink deeper.

lines.zh: 一段触手飘走了，还在扭。
lines.en: A length of tentacle drifts off, still twisting.
I retreat behind the reef.

lines.zh: 这一下我记住了这个位置。
lines.en: I remember this spot now.
I steady my tentacles and rise.
One tentacle gone; I still swim.
I sink to the sea floor.
My big eye stays on you.

lines.zh: 我沉了半尺，礁石挡住你。
lines.en: I sink half a foot; the reef hides you.
My tentacles curled in.
Is that fish floating there?
Throw it into the water.
I swim over, tentacles trailing.
The fish smell is strong; I like it.
More fish in your hand?

lines.zh: 整条鱼滑进了我的嘴里。
lines.en: The whole fish slides into my mouth.
Put your hand in the water and I bite.

lines.zh: 这点鱼腥，只够我闻一闻。
lines.en: That much fish smell is only enough to sniff.

lines.zh: 我收一下触手，再往前探。
lines.en: I pull my tentacles in, then reach forward.
Back off toward the reef.
Your hands smell of fish.
Throw it further out.
The surface shudders; I shrink into the reef.

lines.zh: 我身上滑，你根本按不住。
lines.en: I am slick; you cannot press me down.
I hit the reef.

lines.zh: 我一撞，沙和泥都浮起来。
lines.en: One bump and the sand and silt rise.
I sink into the dark of the floor.
Don't splash; I'm listening.

lines.zh: 我们撞了一下，我绕开了。
lines.en: We bumped and I slid aside.
Your foot came down on my tentacle.
I swim back out of the reef crack.
I press to one side.
My kind live in the deep.
You neither swim nor sail.
I swim off, tentacles trailing.
I gather my tentacles.
This sea is too shallow.
Don't touch my tentacles.
I have many places to go.
Leave these shallows.
I turned and sank.
I let go with my tentacles and sink into the dark.
I curl a tentacle around it.
I can drag this.
It sinks to the sea floor.
I stick it to a tentacle.
This has no smell of fish.
I swim a while dragging it.
Too heavy; I let go.
I push it ashore.
Did you drop this ashore?
The sea doesn't lack this.
Your feet are in my water.

lines.zh: 水底下，我就在你正下方。
lines.en: Under the water, I am right below you.
The water will slow your feet first.
My tentacles are spread.
You can't get back to shore.
I close the circle loop by loop, unhurried.
There are no shallows here.
At three my tentacles tighten.

lines.zh: 水已经把声音带给我了。
lines.en: The water has brought me the sound.
You stepped into my water.
My tentacles are already under the surface.
I drop my pointed head to your waist.
I track you along the sea floor.

lines.zh: 你每一次踩水我都听得到。
lines.en: I hear every kick.

lines.zh: 我挡在浅滩，把你往里推。
lines.en: I block the shallows and push you deeper.
Your feet can't touch bottom.
The current pulls toward me.
That little sound in the water is me closing in.
One foot closer.
I watch your feet from below.
The ripples carry sound to me.
I rise a little higher.
You've backed into the reef rocks.
The gaps between the rocks are narrow.
My tentacles wrap you.

lines.zh: 我的尖头撞在你肋骨上。
lines.en: My pointed head strikes your ribs.
This lash drags half the sea with it.

lines.zh: 我往深处退，把你带下去。
lines.en: I back into the deep, taking you with me.

lines.zh: 水灌进你的鼻子和嘴里。
lines.en: Water floods your nose and mouth.

lines.zh: 我这一圈收紧在你的腰上。
lines.en: This loop tightens around your waist.

lines.zh: 我的触手缠住，你就挣不开。
lines.en: My tentacles hold; you cannot pull free.
I jetted ink.
There is no dodging in water.
I loosen my tentacles.
My tentacles pull you under.
I bite your calf.

lines.zh: 我从看不见底的地方上来了。
lines.en: I have come up from where the bottom cannot be seen.
This sea is cold.
My tentacles are still moving.
I swim one lap along the floor.
The smell of blood arrived first, on the water.

lines.zh: 我的触手一条条在水里张开。
lines.en: One by one my tentacles open in the water.
I float at mid-depth.
There is a sound behind the reef.
I begin patrolling these waters.
I blew one bubble.
I wait behind the reef.
From the sea floor I tilt my head and rise.
The water boils; I dive into the reef.
I fell from height into the water.

lines.zh: 我自己在水里，可我还是难受。
lines.en: I live in water, and still it hurts.

lines.zh: 爆炸把水掀起来，我翻了个身。
lines.en: The blast lifts the water and rolls me over.

lines.zh: 有东西扎穿了我的触手。
lines.en: Something pierced my tentacle.
Violet light spreads through the water.
There is little to eat in this sea.

lines.zh: 电流顺着水过来，我僵了。
lines.en: The current reaches me and I stiffen.

lines.zh: 海水退干，我只能摆触手。
lines.en: The sea drains; I can only flail.
